Rubrics XIII.12 commemorate St Mary on Saturday when a Double concurs with her Office, and the same ordo does so at II Vespers of the Guardian Angels on Friday 2 October (p. 103, Comm. BVM 'O blessed Mother' 68*). The app commemorates the Saturday Office.

The ordo keeps the Innocents' octave day and St Titus at I Vespers of the Holy Name (D2). Diurnal §X and XIV.8-9 exclude Simple Octave Days and Memorials there, and item 2 of the #138 ruling omits the Memorial at Vespers of a Double II Class; the 2026 line repeats 2021's 3 January line, which was the Holy Name's II Vespers. Held open under #390 until clergy confirm.

The ordo keeps St Christopher (M) at I Vespers of St James (D2). Diurnal §VIII and §X and item 2 of the #138 ruling omit the Memorial at Vespers of a Double II Class, as the same ordo does on 2 May, 1 July, 5 August and 14 September; the line is printed alike every year but 2024 (No Comm.). Held open under #390 until clergy confirm.

The ordo keeps St Hadrian (M) at I Vespers of the Nativity of the BVM (D2). Diurnal §VIII and §X and item 2 of the #138 ruling omit the Memorial at Vespers of a Double II Class, as the same ordo does on 2 May, 1 July, 5 August and 14 September; the line is 2023's word for word, and 2017-2018 print No Comm. Held open under #390 until clergy confirm.

The 2026 ordo p. 111 marks Friday 30 October L§ (abstinence and fast) and the Vigil of All Saints on Saturday 31 October §. No other ordo (2017-2019, 2021-2025) fasts on 30 October unless the vigil itself is kept that day (2021, anticipated from Sunday), and the same 2026 ordo does not move the Saturday Vigil of Pentecost's fast to Friday 29 May. The app fasts on the vigil only; 30 October keeps its Friday abstinence.

The ordo gives St Saturninus (one Martyr) The very hairs, the Common of Many Martyrs (2*), at Lauds, as 2023-2024 do; 2017-2022 print the one-Martyr He that hateth. The app keeps the one-Martyr Common until clergy rule.

The ordo p. 119 gives St Saturninus The very hairs (2*) at I Vespers of Advent I, apparently copied from the Lauds line beside it; every earlier ordo prints the one-Martyr This is a Martyr. The app keeps the one-Martyr Common until clergy rule.
